verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for an IAM product's admin console, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI assistant, copilot or task delegation inside Keycloak. The admin console, Admin CLI and REST API are conventional management interfaces, not an AI assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
